chapter: Army cornet and Bix's Bach horn
title: Army service from Normandy, and the cornet carried through the war
summary: He served in anti-aircraft, hit Normandy D plus 4, lost his patriotism and tried to get into a band, carrying the Benge cornet.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Well I called myself a drunken patriot. Because I used to drink a lot and I guess that's where I got my courage but man, I wasn't drinking when I hit Normandy and oh, oh, Lord. So I lost my patriotism fast and tried to get back in a band. It took me from June 10th until around October something. And we went all the way through France and Belgium and so forth up to Aachen / Germany. Ardennes Forest, St. Vith.
However, to get back to Eldon Benge, he made a beautiful cornet for me and I carried it with me all through the War. I used to play bugle calls for our outfit.
And I think that's just what you ought to do right now. (LAUGHTER).
Because we really ought to hear the sound. Can't you do that?
Well I have to warm up first.

I haven't warmed up or anything you know. I did carry/pixy the horn all the way through Europe with me with the Army when I finally got out of my combat outfit and got in Special Service and blew the horn from then on.
